entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-q675-qj96-32m9: golang.org/x/image/tiff has excessive resource consumption in PackBits decompression
entry.content:
golang.org/x/image/tiff has excessive resource consumption in PackBits decompression

Aliases: CVE-2026-46599, GO-2026-5032

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H

Affected:

  • golang.org/x/image — fixed in 0.41.0

The TIFF decoder does not place a limit on the size of PackBits-compressed data. A maliciously-crafted image can exploit this to cause a small image (both in terms of pixel width/height and encoded size) to make the decoder decode large amounts of compressed data.

entry.title: [NEW] GO-2026-6222: Excessive memory allocation during VP8L decoding in golang.org/x/image
entry.content:
Excessive memory allocation during VP8L decoding in golang.org/x/image

Aliases: CVE-2026-46603

Affected:

  • golang.org/x/image — fixed in 0.45.0

VP8L decoding in golang.org/x/image/vp8l can allocate an excessive amount of memory when processing a crafted VP8L image containing many unused Huffman tree groups. This allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service via memory exhaustion.

References:

  • https://go.dev/issue/80069

chi's RealIP Middleware allows IP spoofing via unvalidated X-Forwarded-For header

Malicious Case: 1. A malicious client sends a request with a forged IP in the X-Forwarded-For header: `X-Forwarded-For: <forged-ip>` 2. The proxy appends the actual client’s IP and forwa…

entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-3fxj-6jh8-hvhx: chi Has an IP Spoofing Vulnerability in `middleware.RealIP`
entry.content:
chi Has an IP Spoofing Vulnerability in `middleware.RealIP`

Aliases: CVE-2026-72815, GO-2026-5774

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:L/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware — fixed in 5.3.0

## Summary The `RealIP` middleware in `go-chi/chi` is vulnerable to IP spoofing because it blindly trusts the first (leftmost) element of the `X-Forwarded-For` HTTP header. This allows a remote attacker to bypass IP-based access control lists (ACLs) and rate-limiting mechanisms by providing a spoofed IP address in the header. ## Details In `middleware/realip.go`, the `realIP` function parses the `X-Forwarded-For` header and extracts the first comma-separated value: ```go func realIP(r *http.Request) string { // ... } else if xff := r.Header.Get(xForwardedFor); xff != "" { ip, _, _ = strings.Cut(xff, ",") } // ... } ``` Standard practice for `X-Forwarded-For` is that each proxy appends the client's IP to the end of the list. However, since the client can also prov…

  • https://github.com/go-chi/chi/security/advisories/GHSA-3fxj-6jh8-hvhx

entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-2j9v-p4xj-cjw2: Lima: An arbitrary user in a QEMU VM could gain the root privilege in the VM via the guest agent socket
entry.content:
Lima: An arbitrary user in a QEMU VM could gain the root privilege in the VM via the guest agent socket

Aliases: CVE-2026-53657

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H

Affected:

  • github.com/lima-vm/lima/v2 — fixed in 2.1.3

### Impact On an instance of Lima running with `qemu` driver, an arbitrary user in the VM could access `/run/lima-guestagent.sock` when the guest agent is enabled. This could result in running an arbitrary command with the root privileges in the VM (**not on the host**), as `lima-guestagent.sock` provides the tunneling service for an arbitrary address, including a Unix socket address for privileged daemons like D-Bus. This vulnerability is not exploitable on `vz` driver, as the guest agent uses vsocks instead of Unix sockets. ### Patches Patched in Lima v2.1.3 (8a45892378d22f40505c31a38f786a07701b6d50) > [!NOTE] > The default user account in the VM can still run an arbitrary command as the root via the guest agent socket. > This is not a vulnerability, as the user can already run an ar…

Openshift Migration Advisor: Improper input sanitization allows specially crafted RVTools .xlsx files to include malicious SQL commands

Aliases: CVE-2026-53474

Due to improper input sanitization, malicious SQL embedded within a spreadsheet cell is executed when cluster names are processed. entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-xghw-p77p-3r7x: Fabric CA Developer's Guide: LDAP Injection via Unescaped Username in GetUser Filter
entry.content:
Fabric CA Developer's Guide: LDAP Injection via Unescaped Username in GetUser Filter

Aliases: CVE-2026-53658

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:L/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • github.com/hyperledger/fabric-ca — fixed in 1.5.21

When fabric-ca is configured with an LDAP backend, the username from HTTP Basic authentication is included in an LDAP uid search filter without proper escaping. An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the CA enrollment endpoint could exploit this to perform LDAP injection before password validation, and potentially steer authentication attempts toward a victim account. ### Recommendation - All users of fabric-ca with an LDAP backend should update to a fixed version. - For users not using an LDAP backend, no action is required.

entry.content:
Authorizer: Zero-click account takeover via OAuth identity linking to unverified email accounts

Aliases: CVE-2026-35511

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:P/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

The OAuth callback handler links incoming OAuth identities (Google, GitHub, etc.) to existing accounts matched by email address without verifying that the existing account's email was verified by its original owner. An attacker who pre-registers with a victim's email address (without verifying it) gains persistent password-based access to the victim's account after the victim completes a normal OAuth login. entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-vgwf-h737-ff37: golang.org/x/crypto: Invoking client can cause server deadlock on unexpected responses
entry.content:
golang.org/x/crypto: Invoking client can cause server deadlock on unexpected responses

Aliases: CVE-2026-39830, GO-2026-5017

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:H

Affected:

  • golang.org/x/crypto — fixed in 0.52.0

A malicious SSH peer could send unsolicited global request responses to fill an internal buffer, blocking the connection's read loop. The blocked goroutine could not be released by calling Close(), resulting in a resource leak per connection. Unsolicited global responses are now discarded.

References:

entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-2fqw-7c6r-2cq6: Openshift Migration Advisor agent-API fails to validate JWT source_id claim, allowing cross-tenant data manipulation
entry.content:
Openshift Migration Advisor agent-API fails to validate JWT source_id claim, allowing cross-tenant data manipulation

Aliases: CVE-2026-53471

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N

Affected:

  • github.com/kubev2v/migration-planner — fixed in 0.13.5

A flaw was found in migration-planner. The agent-API middleware processes JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authentication, but its UpdateSourceInventory and UpdateAgentStatus handlers fail to validate the source_id claim within these tokens against the requested source ID. This oversight allows an authenticated attacker with a valid agent token to manipulate data across different tenants, leading to a complete collapse of tenant isolation. This could result in unauthorized overwriting of victim inventory, planting of malicious credential URLs, or corruption of migration assessments.

entry.title: [UPDATED] GO-2026-6218: Avoid quadratic complexity in resolvePath in net/url
entry.content:
Avoid quadratic complexity in resolvePath in net/url

Aliases: CVE-2026-56860

Affected:

  • stdlib — fixed in 1.25.13, 1.26.6, 1.27.0-rc.3

Previously, resolving relative paths containing parent directory ('..') segments performed string conversions and buffer rewrites on each step, resulting in quadratic time complexity and high memory allocation overhead. Now, path resolution operates on a byte buffer using index-based backtracking for '..' segments, eliminating the quadratic time complexity and significantly reducing memory allocations.

References:

  • https://go.dev/cl/803681
